에듀냅중학교 2학년 1학기 중간고사 영어

시험 시간 45분 · 이름: ______________

1. 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것을 고르시오.[4점]
My little sister is very ______ ; she always shares her snacks and toys with everyone at school.
  1. ① rude
  2. ② generous
  3. ③ lazy
  4. ④ nervous
  5. ⑤ silent
2. 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.[8점]
  1. ① She has lived in this town since she was seven years old.
  2. ② Neither of the two boxes were heavy enough to break the shelf.
  3. ③ The coach asked us to arrive at the gym before the sun rose.
  4. ④ Having finished his homework, Minho went out to play soccer.
  5. ⑤ I don't know why the printer stopped working this morning.
3. 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 어색한 것을 고르시오.[8점]
①Although the rain was heavy, the campers ②decided to stay outside. The guide, ③who had walked this trail many times, told them ④to putting on their raincoats and ⑤keep their bags dry.
4. 다음 문장 중 어법상 어색한 것의 개수를 고르시오.[8점]
(a) The number of students who join the club have grown every year.
(b) By the time we arrived, the movie had already started.
(c) This is the pen which I wrote the letter with it.
(d) Not only the teacher but also the students were surprised at the news.
(e) It is important that every member follow the safety rules.
  1. ① 1개
  2. ② 2개
  3. ③ 3개
  4. ④ 4개
  5. ⑤ 5개
5. 다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.[8점]

A: I heard you joined the school band. How is it going?

B: It's fun, but practicing the trumpet every day is tiring.

A: ______________________

B: You're right. I'll ask her for some tips tomorrow.

  1. ① Why don't you ask the music teacher for advice?
  2. ② I think you should quit the band right away.
  3. ③ I have never played a musical instrument before.
  4. ④ The concert was cancelled because of the weather.
  5. ⑤ Let's go watch a movie instead this weekend.
6. 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.[12점]
Many small towns are losing their bookstores because people now buy books online. To bring readers back, one town started holding a monthly book fair in its central square. Local writers give short talks, and children can trade books for free. The fair reminds people that a bookstore is not just a place to buy things but also ______________.
  1. ① a place to meet the writers of famous novels
  2. ② a space where the whole town can gather and connect
  3. ③ the cheapest way to find used textbooks
  4. ④ a shop that only sells books for children
  5. ⑤ a store that will close down within a year
7. 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 순서로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.[12점]
Last spring, our class planted a small vegetable garden behind the school.

(A) By early summer, however, the tomatoes and lettuce had grown taller than we expected.
(B) At first, nothing seemed to happen, and some students doubted the seeds would ever grow.
(C) Seeing the harvest, even the doubtful students agreed to keep the garden going next year.
  1. ① (A)-(B)-(C)
  2. ② (A)-(C)-(B)
  3. ③ (B)-(A)-(C)
  4. ④ (B)-(C)-(A)
  5. ⑤ (C)-(A)-(B)
8. 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 고르시오.[10점]
The city library will host a "Silent Reading Night" every last Friday of the month. The event starts at 7 p.m. and lasts two hours. Visitors may bring their own books or borrow one from the library shelves. Snacks are provided, but visitors must keep noise to a minimum. Registration is required at least one day in advance, and only forty seats are available.
  1. ① 이 행사는 매달 마지막 금요일에 열린다.
  2. ② 행사는 두 시간 동안 진행된다.
  3. ③ 참가자는 반드시 자신의 책을 가져와야 한다.
  4. ④ 간식이 제공되지만 소음은 최소화해야 한다.
  5. ⑤ 좌석은 40석으로 제한되어 있다.
9. [서술형] 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.[16점]
그 다리가 폭풍으로 파손되었음에도 불구하고, 마을 사람들은 그것을 3주 안에 다시 지었다.
<조건> 1) although 로 시작할 것 2) 수동태(be damaged)를 한 번 쓸 것 3) rebuild 를 알맞은 형태로 쓸 것 4) 10단어 이상으로 쓸 것

→

10. [서술형] 다음 두 문장을 <보기>와 같이 한 문장으로 전환하시오.[14점]
<보기> He is honest. He is also diligent. → He is not only honest but also diligent.
She finished the marathon. She also raised money for the hospital.

조건: not only A but also B 구문을 사용하여 한 문장으로 쓸 것

→
